files.README.md:
# Brindlemoor Cold Store - patrol log

logs/patrol.log takes one line per event:

    <date> <event> - <result>

Patrol rounds are kept in sheets/. The clipboard sheet sometimes
re-keys an event, so the same event can appear twice on one round;
each event is logged once, in the order first seen, under the
round's date.

2026-09-26 Door 1 alarm test - reset OK
2026-09-26 Compressor 2 - amps 39 - nominal
2026-09-29 Door 2 alarm test - reset OK
2026-09-29 Door 5 alarm test - reset OK
2026-09-29 Compressor 3 - amps 41 - nominal
